thread:
tara: heads up — the sample-app README (docker + ts example) is out of sync. I tried the quickstart and the container build fails, and the node snippet throws 'Cannot find module 'redwood-sdk''. Repro + suggested fixes below.

kevin: ugh, thanks. paste the failing bits?

tara: failing Dockerfile:
```
FROM node:18
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```
This fails because the sample assumes a build step but package.json is missing a "build" script. Also package references "redwood-sdk" while our npm package is "@redwood/inference".

tara: failing TS snippet from README:
```
import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = new Redwood(process.env.redwood_api_key);
await client.generate(...);
```
should be:
```
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.generate(...);
```

maria: yikes. We should patch main + backport to v1-stable. Also add a CI check that sample-app build actually runs. @kevin can you open a PR?

kevin: on it. opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/4321 — includes Dockerfile fix, package.json build script, and README snippet corrections. CI is pending.

devex-bot: :white_check_mark: CI passed for PR #4321 — all sample app tests green.

tara: awesome, merged to main and backported to v1-stable. added a short note in CHANGELOG. Thanks all :tada:
